query_original: computer vision - machines that understand images and video

scope.disambiguation_notes: The query specifically refers to computer vision as it relates to machines understanding images and video, which is a common interpretation of the field.
initial_task_hypotheses: The system must be able to detect and identify objects within images or video streams.
The system must be capable of interpreting and analyzing visual data to extract meaningful information.
The system must perform image processing tasks such as filtering, enhancement, and transformation.
The system must be able to track and recognize patterns or movements in video sequences.
The system must integrate with machine learning models to improve accuracy and adaptability in visual recognition tasks.

search_plan.rationale: To establish a clear and concise definition of computer vision as a technological domain.
To identify the various subfields and specializations within computer vision.
To understand the fundamental techniques and methods used in computer vision.
To explore the practical applications and use cases of computer vision technology.

search_plan.query_en: technologies similar to computer vision but not the same
search_plan.rationale: To identify technologies that are similar to computer vision but do not perform the same tasks, for exclusion purposes.

search_plan.query_en: CPC IPC classification codes for computer vision
search_plan.rationale: To find the official classification codes that categorize computer vision technologies.
To gather alternative terms and synonyms used for computer vision.
